name: Claude Skill Youtube Kr Subtitle
headline: Korean subtitles for YouTube with Claude Code
short_description: Automatically adds Korean subtitles to YouTube videos using Claude's context-aware translation. Benefits content creators and operations teams by streamlining localization. Connects to YouTube and Claude for subtitle generation and insertion.
author: Koomook

sections.overview:
This skill downloads YouTube videos with English subtitles and uses Claude to generate accurate Korean translations with full contextual understanding. Rather than simple machine translation, it analyzes video content, researches technical terminology, and adapts tone to match the original. The skill automatically resolves common subtitle timing issues, validates translation accuracy, and permanently embeds Korean subtitles into the final video using FFmpeg. Content creators, educational channels, and localization teams benefit by eliminating manual subtitle translation workflows while maintaining professional quality.
Localizing educational YouTube videos for Korean audiences
Adding Korean subtitles to tech tutorials and software walkthroughs
Streamlining subtitle workflow for multi-language content creators
Creating accessible Korean versions of English-language documentaries
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Koomook/claude-skill-youtube-kr-subtitle`
sections.usage:
```
I need to add Korean subtitles to a YouTube video. Here's the video link: [VIDEO_LINK]. The video is in [LANGUAGE]. Please generate accurate Korean subtitles that match the timing and context of the original content. Ensure the translation is natural and culturally appropriate for Korean speakers. Once ready, provide the subtitles in a format compatible with YouTube's subtitle upload system.
```
